breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the physically impossible concentration profile range. It repeated the user's incorrect statement that 'The profile after annealing spans from 10 at% B to 90 at% B.' The ground truth corrects this to span from 20 at% B to 80 at% B, as the concentration cannot extend beyond the initial endpoint compositions in a simple diffusion couple.
